The company shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 577M on revenue of 2,444M, ~24%) and positive retained earnings, supporting earnings stability. However, liquidity is only modest (current ratio 1.18) and leverage is relatively high (total liabilities 26,603M versus equity 14,298M), which increases refinancing and downside risk. Overall, this supports a lower-investment-grade rating.  
DECISION: BBB-
